inputs.text: So they're pushing this line that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump. Organizers claim it beat their last round in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events. AFP is repeating it like it's fact, yet US authorities gave no official count at all. This reeks of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions trying to manufacture the appearance of massive opposition and keep their control intact. The lack of real verification just confirms it's another narrative play to weaken his leadership, not some organic wave of dissent.
